compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is part of a location-sharing application. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Map Display**: A map is shown at the top of the screen, indicating the process of acquiring the user's location.
2. **Send Glympse To**: An option to send a location update to a contact on Facebook.
3. **Watch Me For**: A setting to specify the duration for which the location will be shared, currently set to 15 minutes.
4. **Saying**: A customizable message that will be sent along with the location update, currently set to "Almost there!"
5. **Going To**: An option to pick a destination for the location update.

The screen also includes standard navigation elements such as a back arrow and a share button at the top.
